WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 6 AS first_period, 8 AS last_period
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
web_lines AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, o.fulfilment_type, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, o.fulfilment_type, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN l.net_sales ELSE 0 END) AS click_collect_net,
       SUM(l.net_sales) AS web_net,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN l.net_sales ELSE 0 END) / SUM(l.net_sales), 2) AS click_collect_share_pct
FROM web_lines l
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.business_date
CROSS JOIN params
WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT c.fiscal_period, c.period_start_date, c.period_end_date, c.fully_loaded,
  (SELECT SUM(r.net_sales) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r WHERE r.store_id=900 AND r.business_date BETWEEN c.period_start_date AND c.period_end_date) AS ctrl_web_net,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_web_order o WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN c.period_start_date AND c.period_end_date) AS dispatched
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar c WHERE c.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND c.fiscal_period BETWEEN 6 AND 8 ORDER BY 1

SELECT 'dup_sales_lines' AS chk, COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS n FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-01' AND DATE '2026-02-15'
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_web_orders', COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) FROM fact_web_order
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_sales_line_id', COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) FROM fact_sales_line
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_returns', COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id) FROM fact_return_line
UNION ALL SELECT 'null_fulfil', COUNT(*) FROM fact_web_order WHERE fulfilment_type IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'dispatched_no_ts', COUNT(*) FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected') AND dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL

WITH d AS (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-01' AND DATE '2026-02-15' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.channel_code, f.channel_id, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN d USING (receipt_id, line_no) ORDER BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sales_line_id LIMIT 24

WITH d AS (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
SELECT s.store_id, MIN(f.sale_date) AS first_sale, MAX(f.sale_date) AS last_sale, COUNT(*) AS rows_in_dup_groups
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN d USING (receipt_id, line_no) JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT o.fulfilment_type, o.status, COUNT(*) AS orders, COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS orders_with_lines,
 SUM(CASE WHEN s.store_id<>900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lines_not_900
FROM fact_web_order o LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-15' AND DATE '2025-12-28'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT date_trunc('month', CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)) AS m, o.fulfilment_type,
 COUNT(*) AS orders_nc, SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS with_lines,
 SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stg_sales_line_load f WHERE f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_stg
FROM fact_web_order o WHERE o.status<>'cancelled' AND o.order_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2025-08-01' AND o.order_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2026-02-01'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT s.store_id AS return_store, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(r.refund_net) AS refund_net,
 SUM(CASE WHEN r.return_date <> CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', r.return_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS date_mismatch,
 SUM(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test_rows
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.receipt_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order) AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-22' AND DATE '2025-12-21'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT 'web_test_lines' AS chk, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(f.net_amount) AS amt
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category='ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-15' AND DATE '2025-12-28'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dispatch_utc_vs_helsinki_day_edge', COUNT(*), NULL FROM fact_web_order
WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected') AND CAST(dispatch_ts_utc AS DATE) <> CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
 AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-22' AND DATE '2025-12-21'

SELECT d.fiscal_period, o.fulfilment_type, ROUND(SUM(r.refund_net),2) AS refunds_booked_in_physical_stores
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
WHERE s.store_id<>900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 6 AND 8 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
